title: Terse right label
description: Right header label shortens from "Próxima salida" to just "Salida" — the terser option, trading some explicitness for header brevity, useful if the header needs to shrink at smaller sizes. Left label ("Destino") is unchanged.

changes.intent: Shorten the header text for tighter layouts while keeping the meaning recognizable in context (a countdown column next to a destination list).
changes.detail: Change the static text of the second header span from "Próxima salida" to "Salida". No structural or style change.
